items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'll ask somebody like George Gano. He might know him. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, George you know him...

ctx.x: I don't know. This fella in them all kind of ways. It's an autograph with names.
I'll ask somebody like George Gano. He might know him.
Yeah, George you know him and not only that, everybody knows Sidney Fleuja. He's a good person.
